thread:
carmen: Hi team, carmen here. Day 1. Need help getting project redwood-apac-research-3 hooked up: GCP billing link, cpu quota in asia-southeast1 (n2 vCPU ~24), KMS decrypt for SA runner@redwood-apac-research-3.iam.gserviceaccount.com, and a read-only AWS role arn:arn:aws:iam::555444333222:role/RWD-Logs-Reader. Who should I ping? :wave:

ops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-9922. Please share exact billing account id and full KMS resource path. Cloud-ops will triage during business hours.

mike: Welcome @carmen! I can do quotas + KMS. For CPUs please confirm machine family (n2 ok) and whether you need sustained use. For KMS paste full name like projects/<proj>/locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/<kr>/cryptoKeys/<key>.

carmen: n2-standard-8 types, 24 vCPUs total. KMS key: projects/redwood-apac-research-3/locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/serve/cryptoKeys/artifact-decrypt.

hana: Billing here 4b0. Our APAC billing id is 06H7I8-APAC002. Reply "link apac research" and I'll attach it and enable billing export to dataset billing_apac_research.

carmen: link apac research. Please enable export. Added AWS role ARN to ONB-9922.

mike: Filed quota request for 24 vCPUs and added IAM binding for runner SA to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on artifact-decrypt. Commands I'll run (audit):

``
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-apac-research-3 --billing-account=06H7I8-APAC002
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding artifact-decrypt --location=asia-southeast1 --keyring=serve --member="serviceAccount:runner@redwood-apac-research-3.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

billing-bot: ONB-9922 updated: billing link requested, KMS binding queued, GCP quota submitted. Assignees: hana (billing), mike (cloud-ops). ETA ~1 business day.

carmen: Thanks all! One quick Q: if quota takes time, is there a recommended fallback region?

mike: us-central1 or europe-west1 are usually free for short eval runs. If you need a faster workaround I can provision a temporary dev role for you.

carmen: Please provision the temp role, that'll help. Appreciate it :pray:
